items.title: Are Data Centers Driving Up Rent Prices In Chicago? Study Says Yes
items.description: The city’s growing number of data centers is driving up demand for housing as well as for electricity and water. Since March, Chicago rents have gone up 4.6 percent.

items.title: Otto’s, An All-Day Bar, Restaurant And Cafe, Opens Thursday In Ukrainian Village
items.description: The new venture from employees at Heisler Hospitality is taking over the long-vacant Grace Auto Clinic property near Chicago and Damen.

items.title: Quantum Campus Neighbors Don’t Want $1 Billion In Public Funds Spent On South Side Megaproject
items.description: About 78 percent of voters nearest to the South Chicago quantum park under construction disapprove of public funds committed to the project, while 88 percent support a "transparent" cleanup of the site.

items.title: Begyle Wins Big As 4 Other Chicago Beers Medal At Barrel-Aged Beer Festival
items.description: Nearly 50 Chicago-made barrel-aged beers were on display at the 24th annual celebration of what barrels can do to beer.

items.title: Could Rainbow Motel’s Towering Neon Sign Be Saved? Owner Now Says He Backs Restoration
items.description: The Chicago Sign Museum is working with the owners of the South Side motel to save the 40-foot sign, but restoration could cost more than $10,000.

items.title: Friendsgiving Potluck In Pilsen To Raise Money For Immigrant Bond Fund
items.description: Three 20-something neighbors are organizing Sunday’s event to "liberate and unite families this holiday season.”

items.title: Thanksgiving To Go? Here’s Where To Buy Your Turkey And More
items.description: Check out our guide to restaurants from Hyde Park to Rogers Park offering full meals and à la carte options for pickup on or before the big day.

items.title: California Blue Line Station Will Finally Get Elevators, New Stairs In $40 Million Revamp
items.description: The station, which saw more than  1.2 million riders last year, will get two elevators, new stairs and doors and bigger platforms, the CTA announced in approving the project contract.
